title: Tools to Replace Spreadsheets in Operations Management
summary: See tools to replace spreadsheets in operations management, with relational data and custom apps.
body_markdown:
Replacing spreadsheets in operations management requires a tool with real relational **Tables** , not just a grid of cells. In **Jestor** , **Build Apps** turns existing spreadsheets into applications with **ready-made templates** , automation, and access control.


## Why spreadsheets stop working as the operation grows?


Spreadsheets don't have real version control, granular permissions, or native automation. They work fine at first, but become a source of error and rework as soon as more than one person needs to edit the same data.


## What companies are trying to solve when leaving spreadsheets behind?


- Typos and conflicting versions edited by different people
- No automation for repetitive tasks inside the spreadsheet
- No control over who can view or edit each piece of information
- Difficulty connecting data across different spreadsheets


## How the migration from spreadsheet to app works?


An existing spreadsheet can be uploaded directly to become the base of a structured application.

## Why choose Jestor?


- You can upload the existing spreadsheet and the system already builds apps and processes on top of it
- Tables support formulas, conditional fields, and connections between different data sets
- Ready-made templates offer a more structured starting point than a spreadsheet from scratch


## Frequently Asked Questions


### Do I need to rebuild everything from scratch when leaving spreadsheets?


No, you can upload the existing spreadsheet and the system creates the initial structure from it.


### Can I export the data back to a spreadsheet later?


Yes, data can be exported at any time.


### Does the migration require technical knowledge?


No, uploading a spreadsheet and turning it into an app is done with no code. Learn more at jestor.com.
